<!-- content/components/media-frame.md -->

---
title: Media Frame
section: Components
order: 10
description: An aspect-locked, square-cornered frame for images and video, with a poster-under-video stack and an optional 1px stroke.
status: live
framer: ResponsiveCaseStudyImage (vIFnGmg), ResponsiveCaseStudyVideo (bsTLKCt), CaseStudyThumbnailStrokeStyles (Z28JYvA), CaseStudyVideoManager (rGMwETR)
codeFileId: vIFnGmg
classes: [mh-media]
tokens: [color.*.bg.media, color.*.border.stroke, motion.scale.hover, motion.duration.base]
---

# Media Frame

## Examples

```html example
<div class="mh-split">
  <a class="mh-media" href="#"><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia.jpg" alt="Gaia app on a phone resting on a mirror in a field of daisies"></a>
  <a class="mh-media" data-stroke href="#"><img src="../../assets/samples/airpods.jpg" alt="AirPods Pro 3 earbuds on a white background"></a>
</div>
```

### Ratios

```html example
<div class="ds-demo-row" style="align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:nowrap">
  <div class="mh-media" style="flex:1.6"><img src="../../assets/samples/peak-energy.jpg" alt=""></div>
  <div class="mh-media" data-ratio="4:5" style="flex:1"><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia-portrait.jpg" alt=""></div>
  <div class="mh-media" data-ratio="1:1" style="flex:1"><img src="../../assets/samples/national-park-cards.jpg" alt=""></div>
</div>
```

### Video with poster

```html
<div class="mh-media">
  <img src="poster.jpg" alt="">
  <video src="clip.mp4" poster="poster.jpg" muted loop playsinline autoplay preload="metadata"></video>
</div>
```

## Usage

- **Square corners, always.** No radius, no shadow.
- **16:9 is the default** for thumbnails and hero media. Use 4:5 / 1:1 / 3:2 in case-study galleries when the asset calls for it, and `auto` to keep an asset's own ratio.
- **Stroke** (`data-stroke`): a 1px Stroke Gray inset outline, for media on white or near-cream backgrounds (product shots, UI) that would otherwise bleed into the page. It's a per-project CMS field (`Thumbnail Stroke`).
- **Hover**: when the frame is in a link, the image scales to 1.02 over 420ms Snappy. The frame stays still.
- **Video**: the poster image stays painted under the video, and the video fades in once it can play. Never leave a blank frame between them.
- Placeholder color is white (`--mh-bg-media`).

## API

| Attribute | Values | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `class="mh-media"` | n/a | `position: relative`, `overflow: hidden`, 16:9, children cover |
| `data-ratio` | `4:3`, `3:2`, `1:1`, `4:5`, `auto` | Aspect ratio |
| `data-stroke` | n/a | 1px inset `--mh-border-stroke` outline |

## Accessibility

- Every meaningful image needs `alt` that describes it ("AirPods Pro 3 earbuds on a white background"). Decorative duplicates (posters under video) get `alt=""`.
- Autoplay video must be `muted` and `playsinline`, and must pause under reduced motion or offscreen.

## Framer mapping

- Case-study media: `ResponsiveCaseStudyImage` (`vIFnGmg`) and `ResponsiveCaseStudyVideo` (`bsTLKCt`); galleries: `CaseStudyJustifiedMediaGrid` (`c0iPrbN`), `DoubleStackGalleryGrid`, `MatchedStackMediaPair`.
- Stroke: `CaseStudyThumbnailStrokeStyles` (`Z28JYvA`) reads the CMS `Thumbnail Stroke` field (`OHdUYs6Mo`) and paints `#979797`.
- Playback budget and offscreen pausing: `CaseStudyVideoManager` (`rGMwETR`). Don't add a second video controller.
- Optimize media with `code/tools/` image-optimizer before upload (see `docs/performance-media-deployment-checklist-2026-07-23.md`).

## Don't

- Don't round corners or add captions inside the frame.
- Don't letterbox with colored bars; crop with `object-fit: cover`.
- Don't scale the frame on hover; scale the image inside it.

# Project Card

## Examples

### Two columns (Home)

```html example
<ul class="mh-project-grid">
  <li class="mh-project-card">
    <a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#">
      <div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label">
        <span>1</span><span>/</span>
        <span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Gaia</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project</span></span></span>
      </div>
      <div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia.jpg" alt="Gaia app on a phone resting on a mirror in a field of daisies"></div>
    </a>
    <ul class="mh-tags"><li class="mh-tag">Visual identity</li><li class="mh-tag">UX/UI</li><li class="mh-tag">Strategy</li></ul>
  </li>
  <li class="mh-project-card">
    <a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#">
      <div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label">
        <span>2</span><span>/</span>
        <span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>AirPods Pro 3</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project</span></span></span>
      </div>
      <div class="mh-media" data-stroke><img src="../../assets/samples/airpods.jpg" alt="AirPods Pro 3 earbuds on a white background"></div>
    </a>
    <ul class="mh-tags"><li class="mh-tag">2D motion</li><li class="mh-tag">3D motion</li><li class="mh-tag">Social media</li></ul>
  </li>
</ul>
```

### Three columns (Other projects, Index grid)

```html example
<ul class="mh-project-grid" data-columns="3">
  <li class="mh-project-card"><a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#"><div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>2</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>AirPods Pro 3</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project</span></span></span></div><div class="mh-media" data-stroke><img src="../../assets/samples/airpods.jpg" alt=""></div></a></li>
  <li class="mh-project-card"><a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#"><div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>3</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Peak Energy</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project</span></span></span></div><div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/peak-energy.jpg" alt=""></div></a></li>
  <li class="mh-project-card"><a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#"><div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>4</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Gaia</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project</span></span></span></div><div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia.jpg" alt=""></div></a></li>
</ul>
```

## Anatomy

1. **Meta row**: mono label in a `24px 11px 1fr` grid: number, slash, title. The title is a flip rail whose second line reads **VIEW PROJECT**.
2. **Media**: [Media Frame](media-frame.md), 16:9, optional 1px stroke.
3. **Tags**: up to three [Tags](tag.md), outside the link so they can be their own filters.

## Usage

- Number cards in display order from 1, without zero padding. Titles are CMS titles, uppercased by CSS.
- Hover or focus does two things together: the title rolls up to VIEW PROJECT and the image scales to 1.02 (both 420ms Snappy). Below 810px neither moves.
- Keep a poster image under any thumbnail video, so a returning visitor never sees an empty frame.

| Grid | Desktop | Tablet | Mobile | Where |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mh-project-grid` | 2 | 2 | 1 | Home: exactly six cards, then View all right-aligned 30px below (20px phone) |
| `data-columns="3"` | 3 | 2 | 1 | Case-study Other projects (three cards, no tags); Index grid view |

Gaps are 20px between columns and 50px between rows. No masonry, mixed sizes or pagination.

## API

| Class | Element | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mh-project-grid` | `ul` | 2-column grid; `data-columns="3"` for three |
| `mh-project-card` | `li` / `article` | Column, 16px gap |
| `mh-project-card__link` | `a` | Wraps meta + media; the hover host |
| `mh-project-card__meta` | `div.mh-label` | `24px 11px 1fr` grid; 13px flip window |

## Data model (CMS)

Cards come from the Framer CMS `All Projects` collection (`yTHrQWMIY`). Never add baked fallback rows or hard-coded media URLs.

| Card field | CMS field | Field id |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Title | Title | `oeXZcmPna` |
| href | `/case-studies/{slug}` | `pdXVG_fBO` |
| Poster image | Thumbnail | `Jy7hBJady` |
| Video | Thumbnail Video | `SvOqFqdby` |
| `data-stroke` | Thumbnail Stroke | `OHdUYs6Mo` |
| Tags | Category 1–3 | (discipline fields) |

## Accessibility

- The link's accessible name is "1 / Gaia"; the VIEW PROJECT line is `aria-hidden`.
- Media `alt` describes the image, not the project name.

## Framer mapping

- Home: `HomeSelectedWorkGrid` (`FecepLS`): six CMS-limited items, `Thumbnail Video` over a `Thumbnail` poster, first-row videos preloaded, CMS rows reused on return navigation. Read `docs/framer-current-state.md` before editing it.
- Other projects: `OtherProjectCardRestored` (`vlwa5Cz`).
- Index grid: `IndexPage` (`rgAZFOv`) through `IndexPageGridPreview` (`LgIzFjJ`), which supplies the three-column `figma` layout (56px row gap). Never overwrite the wrapper.

# Index List

## Examples

```html example
<ol class="mh-index" reversed>
  <li class="mh-index__group">
    <h3 class="mh-index__year">2026</h3>
    <ul class="mh-index__rows">
      <li><a class="mh-index__row" href="#">
        <span class="mh-index__title"><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Caliper Sans</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project →</span></span></span></span>
        <span class="mh-index__discipline mh-label">Type design</span>
        <span class="mh-index__industry mh-label">Technology</span><span class="mh-index__row-year mh-label">2026</span>
      </a></li>
      <li><a class="mh-index__row" href="#">

      </a></li>
      <li><a class="mh-index__row" href="#">
        <span class="mh-index__title"><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Peak Energy</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project →</span></span></span></span>
        <span class="mh-index__discipline mh-label">Visual identity</span>
        <span class="mh-index__industry mh-label">Technology</span><span class="mh-index__row-year mh-label">2026</span>
      </a></li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li class="mh-index__group">
    <h3 class="mh-index__year">2025</h3>
    <ul class="mh-index__rows">
      <li><a class="mh-index__row" href="#">
        <span class="mh-index__title"><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>AirPods Pro 3</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project →</span></span></span></span>
        <span class="mh-index__discipline mh-label">2D motion, 3D motion</span>
        <span class="mh-index__industry mh-label">Technology</span><span class="mh-index__row-year mh-label">2025</span>
      </a></li>
      <li><a class="mh-index__row" href="#">
        <span class="mh-index__title"><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Motion Connect 2025</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project →</span></span></span></span>
        <span class="mh-index__discipline mh-label">Event identity</span>

      </a></li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
```

## Anatomy

| Column | Content | Type | Below 1200px | Below 810px |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Year | Group label, first column, once per group | Title, 22px | Kept | Stacked above rows |
| Title | Project name, uppercase; rolls to "View Project →" on hover | Title, 22px | Kept | 22px |
| Discipline | Comma-joined disciplines | Mono label | Hidden | Hidden |
| Industry | One industry | Mono label, right-aligned | Kept | Kept |

## Usage

- Groups are years, newest first. A full-width rule opens each group; rules separate rows inside it; a final rule closes the list.
- Text is near-black (`--mh-text-strong`), not Forest Green. This is the one dense, data-like surface on the site.
- Row hover: a 4% near-black wash (150ms Smooth) plus the title rolling up to **View Project →** (420ms Snappy, like every flip).
- **Mobile** (below 810px): no year group labels. Each row is a 56px link with the 22px uppercase title on the left and its year in 13px mono on the right; industry and discipline are hidden. Rows don't roll.
- The list sits under the [Filter Group](index-controls.md) and the [View Toggle](index-controls.md); filtering hides rows and empty groups without moving the filters.

## API

| Class | Element | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mh-index` | `ol` | Wrapper; `reversed` if numbering matters |
| `mh-index__group` | `li` | Grid `1fr 5fr`, top rule |
| `mh-index__year` | `h3` | Year label |
| `mh-index__rows` | `ul` | Rows, divided by rules |
| `mh-index__row` | `a` | Grid `2fr 2fr 1fr`; hover wash, 2px radius |
| `mh-index__title` | `span` | Holds a flip rail (`--mh-flip-h: 1.2em`) |
| `mh-index__discipline`, `mh-index__industry` | `span.mh-label` | Ellipsis on overflow; hidden on mobile |
| `mh-index__row-year` | `span.mh-label` | The row's year, shown only below 810px (right-aligned, 13px) |

## Data model (CMS)

```json
{ "title": "Gaia", "slug": "gaia", "year": 2026, "category1": "Visual identity", "category2": "UX/UI", "category3": "Strategy", "industry": "Nature", "sortOrder": 2 }
```

Fields map to `All Projects` (`yTHrQWMIY`). Years come from the CMS; never hard-code groups.

## Accessibility

- Year headings make the groups navigable by heading.
- Each row is a single link whose name is the project title (the View Project → line is `aria-hidden`).

## Framer mapping

- `IndexPage` (`rgAZFOv`), mounted through `IndexPageGridPreview` (`LgIzFjJ`). Text and dividers render `#141414` through color property controls.
- Content arrives progressively on first load (6 rows, then +12 per frame); filter toggles never unmount the list.
- Read `docs/index-component-instructions.md` before editing. The CMS mode is generated-module only; there are no manual rows or `DEFAULT_PROJECTS`.

## Don't

- Don't add thumbnails to list rows (grid view exists for that).
- Don't color rows by discipline or industry.
- Don't use zebra striping.

---
title: Index Controls
section: Components
order: 14
description: The controls above the Index. Year / Service / Industry filters (disclosure buttons on mobile), the project count and the GRID / LIST toggle.
status: live
framer: IndexPage (rgAZFOv) via IndexPageGridPreview (LgIzFjJ)
codeFileId: rgAZFOv
classes: [mh-filter, mh-filter__group, mh-filter__heading, mh-filter__toggle, mh-filter__options, mh-filter__item, mh-filter__done, mh-filter__clear, mh-count, mh-view-toggle]
tokens: [type.label, color.*.text.interactive, color.*.text.strong, motion.duration.instant, motion.duration.fast, motion.ease.smooth, layout.touch-target]
---

# Index Controls

## Filters

```html example
<div class="mh-filter" role="group" aria-label="Filter projects">
  <fieldset class="mh-filter__group">
    <legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Year</legend>
    <button class="mh-filter__toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="filter-year">Year</button>
    <div class="mh-filter__options" id="filter-year">
      <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">2026</button>
      <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">2025</button>
      <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">2024</button>
      <button class="mh-filter__done" type="button">Done</button>
    </div>
  </fieldset>
  <fieldset class="mh-filter__group">
    <legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Service</legend>
    <button class="mh-filter__toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="filter-service">Service</button>
    <div class="mh-filter__options" id="filter-service">
      <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Packaging</button>
      <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Product</button>
      <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Strategy</button>
      <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Visual identity</button>
      <button class="mh-filter__done" type="button">Done</button>
    </div>
  </fieldset>
  <fieldset class="mh-filter__group">
    <legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Industry</legend>
    <button class="mh-filter__toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="filter-industry">Industry</button>
    <div class="mh-filter__options" id="filter-industry">
      <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Literature</button>
      <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Nature</button>
      <button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Technology</button>
      <button class="mh-filter__done" type="button">Done</button>
    </div>
  </fieldset>
  <button class="mh-filter__clear mh-action" type="button">Clear filters</button>
</div>
```

Click items to toggle; "Clear filters" appears once one is active. Below 810px the groups collapse into disclosure buttons; resize to see them.

- Three taxonomies in this order: **Year**, **Service** (disciplines), **Industry**, all from the CMS. Selections combine as OR within a group and AND across groups, and apply immediately.
- Selected items turn Accent Green with a leading dot; hover previews the color.
- **Clear filters** is always rendered and only toggles `visibility`, so filtering never shifts the layout.
- Filter state lives in the URL: `#service=packaging` in, `?service=` out.
- **Mobile:** three equal disclosure buttons, 12px apart between two 1px rules. Triggers are 48px tall with a chevron that flips when open. One panel opens at a time, full width, growing out of its trigger (4px drop, 0.97 scale, 250ms Smooth) and closing in 150ms. Options, Done and Clear filters are 44px targets. Done, Escape and a tap outside close the panel and return focus to its trigger.

## Count

A polite live region under the filters ("17 Projects"). Digits sit in fixed-width tabular slots so the line never shifts; when the count changes, only the changed digits cross-fade (150ms Smooth). Screen readers hear the plain number once.

```html example
<p class="mh-label" role="status" aria-live="polite"><span class="mh-count" data-total="17" data-value="17"></span></p>
<div class="ds-demo-row" style="margin-top:16px">
  <button class="mh-action" data-variant="pill" type="button" onclick="mhSetCount(this.closest('.ds-preview').querySelector('.mh-count'), 5)">Filter to 5</button>
  <button class="mh-action" data-variant="pill" type="button" onclick="mhSetCount(this.closest('.ds-preview').querySelector('.mh-count'), 17)">Clear</button>
</div>
```

## View toggle

```html example
<div class="mh-view-toggle" role="group" aria-label="View">
  <button type="button" value="grid" aria-pressed="false">Grid</button>
  <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
  <button type="button" value="list" aria-pressed="true">List</button>
</div>
```

Right-aligned on the line above the list or grid. Two options; the active one is underlined (1px, 3px offset). Switching keeps the filters and scroll position. 44×44px buttons on mobile. No icons, no third view.

## API

| Class / attribute | Element | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mh-filter` | `div` | Grid `1fr 2fr 2fr 1fr`; `data-active` while any item is pressed |
| `mh-filter__group` | `fieldset` | One taxonomy; `legend.mh-filter__heading` names it |
| `mh-filter__toggle` | `button[aria-expanded][aria-controls]` | Mobile disclosure trigger |
| `mh-filter__options` | `div` | The group's items, plus `mh-filter__done` on mobile |
| `mh-filter__item` | `button[aria-pressed]` | 13px mono, 28px line height |
| `mh-filter__clear` | `button.mh-action` | Visible only with `data-active` |
| `mh-count` | `span[data-total]` | `mhSetCount(el, n)` updates it (`components.js`) |
| `mh-view-toggle` | `div[role=group]` | `data-target` receives `data-view` from the pressed `value` |
| `mh:filter` | event | Fired on change with `detail.values` |

## Framer mapping

- All three live inside `IndexPage` (`rgAZFOv`), mounted through `IndexPageGridPreview` (`LgIzFjJ`), which also exposes the default **View** control. Taxonomy follows Figma node `32:7531`; hover/active color `#25593a`; URL sync has a kill switch (`ENABLE_URL_FILTER_SYNC`); grid tags toggle the same filters through `IndexFilterContext`.
- Interaction timing inside IndexPage: `--idx-motion-feedback` 150ms and `--idx-motion-switch` 250ms on the Smooth curve.
- Read `docs/index-component-instructions.md` before editing.

## Don't

- No checkboxes, select menus or search field for these filters.
- No per-item counts.

---

# Meta Grid

## Examples

```html example
<div class="mh-meta-grid">
  <dl class="mh-meta-grid__col">
    <div class="mh-meta-grid__item">
      <dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ About the project</dt>
      <dd class="mh-text-body-lg">A photograph becomes a data point. A data point becomes a record. A record becomes a reason to care. Gaia is a rebrand and redesign of iNaturalist, turning the world's largest biodiversity platform from a tool for experts into an open invitation to notice and protect the living world.</dd>
    </div>
    <div class="mh-meta-grid__item">
      <dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Industry</dt>
      <dd class="mh-text-body-lg">Nature</dd>
    </div>
  </dl>
  <dl class="mh-meta-grid__col">
    <div class="mh-meta-grid__item">
      <dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Scope</dt>
      <dd class="mh-text-body-lg">Visual Identity, UX/UI, Strategy</dd>
    </div>
    <div class="mh-meta-grid__item">
      <dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Credits</dt>
      <dd class="mh-text-body-lg">Client: Self-Initiated Proposal<br>Designer: Micah Hoang</dd>
    </div>
    <div class="mh-meta-grid__item">
      <dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Year</dt>
      <dd class="mh-text-body-lg">2026</dd>
    </div>
  </dl>
</div>
```

## Usage

- Sits directly under the case-study hero media.
- **Left column**: About the project (the lead paragraph), then Industry.
- **Right column**: Scope, Credits, Year.
- Labels start with `/ `. Values are Body L in near-black.
- Credits are exact and one per line: `Role: Name`. Name collaborators; say "Designer: Micah Hoang" only if that's true.

## API

| Class | Element | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mh-meta-grid` | `div` | Two columns, 30px gap; stacks below 810px |
| `mh-meta-grid__col` | `dl` | 40px between items (36px mobile) |
| `mh-meta-grid__item` | `div` | `dt` label (`/Small Mono`) + `dd` value (`/Body L`: 22 / 18 / 15px), 15px gap |

## Data model (CMS)

```json
{ "about": "A photograph becomes a data point…", "industry": "Nature", "scope": ["Visual Identity", "UX/UI", "Strategy"], "credits": [{ "role": "Client", "name": "Self-Initiated Proposal" }, { "role": "Designer", "name": "Micah Hoang" }], "year": 2026 }
```

## Framer mapping

- Native case-study "Descriptor" section on each bespoke `/case-studies/{slug}` page.
- On mobile, `CaseStudyMobileDescriptorLayout` (`W62Sy75`) reorders the descriptor columns. Keep the same DOM order (About, Industry, Scope, Credits, Year) so it works.

## Don't

- Don't render the meta as a table with borders.
- Don't add icons or pills to values.

<!-- content/components/lightbox.md -->

---
title: Lightbox
section: Components
order: 17
description: A white full-screen viewer for case-study media, with thin near-black arrows and a quick zoom.
status: live
framer: CaseStudyLightbox (F2K4_SV) via CaseStudyControllers (z13WRHS)
codeFileId: F2K4_SV
classes: [mh-lightbox, mh-lightbox__media, mh-lightbox__btn]
tokens: [color.*.bg.media, color.primitive.near-black, motion.duration.zoom, space.11, z.overlay]
---

# Lightbox

## Examples

Click any image to open the viewer. Use ← → to step through and Esc to close.

```html example
<div class="mh-split" data-mh-lightbox>
  <div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia.jpg" alt="Gaia app on a phone in a field of daisies"></div>
  <div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/peak-energy.jpg" alt="Peak Energy battery modules, line illustration"></div>
</div>
```

## Usage

- Opt in a gallery or section by adding `data-mh-lightbox` to its container; every `img` inside becomes openable and steppable.
- Backdrop is white, chrome is near-black at weight 300, 24px. No counter by default.
- Zoom is 260ms Snappy and starts **from the clicked thumbnail**: the live component clones the media over its source rect, keeps it opaque, and zooms it to full size while the white backdrop fades in. The `components.js` version here is a simplified center scale (0.96 → 1), opening in 250ms and closing in 150ms (exits faster than entries); match the live behavior, not the demo.
- Tapping the image advances; navigation loops.
- 72px padding around the media on desktop, 16px on mobile.

## API

| Hook | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `data-mh-lightbox` (container) | Images inside open the lightbox (`components.js`) |
| `.mh-lightbox[data-open]` | Generated overlay; `role="dialog"` `aria-modal="true"` |
| `.mh-lightbox__btn[data-dir]` | `prev`, `next`, `close` |

## Accessibility

- Focus moves to Close on open and returns to the clicked image on close.
- Esc closes; arrow keys step. Page scroll is locked while open.
- Buttons have `aria-label`s; the image keeps its `alt`.

## Framer mapping

- `CaseStudyLightbox` (`F2K4_SV`), loaded by `CaseStudyControllers` (`z13WRHS`) at a pinned module hash. If you republish the lightbox, bump the pinned hash in the controller.
- Controls (defaults): Background `rgb(255,255,255)`, Arrows/X `rgb(20,20,20)`, Icon Weight 300, Icon Size 24px, Zoom 260ms, Padding 72px, Tap = Next on, Loop on, Counter off, Videos on.
- The lightbox sits outside Lenis smooth scrolling (`data-lenis-prevent`).

## Don't

- Don't darken the backdrop; the viewer is white like a light table.
- Don't add captions, thumbnails strips or share buttons.

codeFileId: tpDdaaJ

---

# Testimonial

## Examples

```html example
<figure class="mh-testimonial" data-items='[{"quote":"Micah turned a loose brief into a system the whole team could build on.","name":"Client Name","role":"Creative Director, Studio"},{"quote":"Every decision came with a reason, and every reason held up.","name":"Second Client","role":"Head of Brand, Company"}]'>
  <p class="mh-label">What our clients say:</p>
  <blockquote class="mh-testimonial__quote">Micah turned a loose brief into a system the whole team could build on.</blockquote>
  <figcaption class="mh-testimonial__cite">
    <span class="mh-testimonial__name">Client Name</span>
    <span class="mh-testimonial__role">Creative Director, Studio</span>
  </figcaption>
  <div class="mh-testimonial__controls mh-label">
    <button class="mh-action" type="button" data-dir="prev" aria-label="Previous testimonial">←</button>
    <button class="mh-action" type="button" data-dir="next" aria-label="Next testimonial">→</button>
  </div>
</figure>
```

The quotes above are placeholders. Use only real, attributed quotes.

## Usage

- Quote in GT Standard Regular, 48px with 1.12 leading (×0.8 on tablet, ×0.62 on mobile), max 820px wide.
- Name 20px, role 16px muted. Label 13px mono above.
- Arrows are typed characters (← →) in mono, not icons. Autoplay is off.
- On mobile the live component clamps long quotes to 6 lines with a "Read more".
- Lines reveal one by one (mask rise) when the quote changes.

## API

| Class / attribute | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `mh-testimonial` | `figure`; `data-items` JSON array of `{quote, name, role}` enables stepping |
| `mh-testimonial__quote` | `blockquote` |
| `mh-testimonial__cite` | `figcaption` with `__name` and `__role` |
| `[data-dir="prev" \| "next"]` | Step buttons |

## Framer mapping

- `TestimonialLineReveal` (`tpDdaaJ`). Controls: Label ("What our clients say:"), Arrows (← →), Autoplay off / 5s, Align left, Mobile Read More on, Clamp Lines 6, Max Width 820, Quote Size 48, Tablet Scale 0.8, Mobile Scale 0.62, Quote Leading 1.12, Name Size 20, Role Size 16, Label Size 13.

## Don't

- Don't use quotation-mark graphics, avatars or star ratings.
- Don't invent or paraphrase testimonials.

<!-- content/components/page-loader.md -->

---
title: Page Loader
section: Components
order: 20
description: The first-visit boot curtain. Forest Green, a Cream progress bar, the ©MH monogram centered, then a lift.
status: live
framer: PageTransition (gmalnRr) + PageTransitionRuntime (rdTIUkW)
codeFileId: gmalnRr
classes: [mh-loader, mh-loader__bar, mh-loader__identity, mh-monogram]
tokens: [color.primitive.forest-green, color.primitive.cream, motion.duration.page, z.loader, component.monogram.*]
---

# Page Loader

## Examples

```html example bleed
<div class="ds-demo-frame">
  <div class="mh-loader" data-contained>
    <span class="mh-loader__bar"></span>
    <img class="mh-loader__identity mh-monogram" src="../../assets/identity/monogram-cream.svg" alt="©MH" style="--mh-monogram-size: 160px">
  </div>
  <button class="mh-action" data-variant="pill" type="button" data-play-loader style="position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:16px;color:var(--mh-text-brand)">Replay</button>
</div>
```

Press **Replay** to run the sequence.

## Sequence

| Step | What happens | Timing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Boot | Forest Green covers the viewport; the ©MH [monogram](../foundations/identity.md) centered in Cream | Painted at parse time, before the app hydrates |
| 2. Progress | An 8px Cream bar fills from the left along the top edge | ≥ 1200ms (`bootMinMs`), Smooth |
| 3. Identity out | The monogram fades | 420ms, during bar completion |
| 4. Lift | The curtain slides up and off | 1200ms, Snappy |

## Usage

- **Home only, first visit only** (direct entries and reloads of `/`). Never on internal navigations, case studies or mobile ≤ the boot-disable width.
- The identity is the ©MH [monogram](../foundations/identity.md) as inline SVG (three paths, no font or image request): 237.5px wide on desktop, 190px on tablet, capped at the viewport minus 64px, centered as a whole lockup. The demo above is scaled down.
- `theme-color` and the page canvas are synced to Cream, so mobile browser chrome doesn't flash green afterward.
- Videos behind the curtain hold until it lifts.

## API

| Class / attribute | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `mh-loader` | Fixed full-viewport curtain. `data-contained` makes it `position:absolute` for previews |
| `mh-loader__bar` | 8px progress bar (scaleX) |
| `mh-loader__identity` | Centered name |
| `data-state` | `idle` → `loading` → `done` → `lifted` |
| `data-autoplay` / `window.mhPlayLoader(el)` | Run the sequence (`components.js`) |

## Framer mapping

- `PageTransition` (`gmalnRr`) owns the boot loader and every route transition (view-transition curtain, prerender speculation rules, appear replay). Controls: `Boot` Show/Off, `Boot mode` Auto/Always, `Boot color` `#233324`, `Bar color` `#F7F5F0`, `Bar height` 8px, `bootMinMs` 1200.
- Read `docs/framer-page-transition.md` before changing anything here. **Don't build a second loader or transition layer.**

## Don't

- Don't show percentages, spinners or a logo animation.
- Don't run the loader on every navigation.

# Home

## Goal

A senior design lead should get the read in ten seconds: **brand designer, systems thinker, high craft, real shipped work.** Home shows six projects, not all of them.

## Structure

| # | Section | Components | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Boot (first visit) | [Page Loader](../components/page-loader.md) | Home only |
| 1 | Nav | [Navigation](../components/navigation.md) | Same as every page |
| 2 | Hero | [Hero](../components/hero.md) (home) | Name, two-line descriptor, link list + ©2026 |
| 3 | Selected work | Rule-only [Section Header](../components/section-header.md), [Project Grid](../components/project-card.md) | No title since 2026-11-11; 6 projects, 2 columns, "View all" right-aligned below |
| 4 | About Micah | Section Header, portrait [Media Frame](../components/media-frame.md), Body L, [Action](../components/links-actions.md) "Read more" | Portrait left, copy right. Hovering the image or the link triggers both (image scale + link flip) |
| 5 | Scroll to top | [Scroll to Top](../components/links-actions.md) | Left gutter, 60px below the About content |
| 6 | Footer | [Footer](../components/footer.md) | Forest Green |
| n/a | Texture | [Grain Overlay](../foundations/texture.md) | Page-level |

## Example (condensed)

```html example bleed
<div class="mh-container" style="padding-bottom:var(--mh-section-padding-y)">
  <header class="mh-hero">
    <h1 class="mh-hero__name mh-text-display-xl">Micah Hoang</h1>
    <p class="mh-hero__descriptor mh-text-heading">Brand designer with a systems mind.</p>
    <div class="mh-hero__bar">
      <ul class="mh-link-list mh-label"><li><a class="mh-link" href="#">LinkedIn</a></li><li><a class="mh-link" href="#">Resume</a></li><li><a class="mh-link" href="#">Email</a></li><li><a class="mh-link" href="#">Cosmos</a></li></ul>
      <span class="mh-label">©2026</span>
    </div>
  </header>
  <section>
    <header class="mh-section-header" data-variant="rule">
      <hr class="mh-rule">
    </header>
    <ul class="mh-project-grid">
      <li class="mh-project-card"><a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#"><div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>1</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Gaia</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project</span></span></span></div><div class="mh-media"><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia.jpg" alt=""></div></a><ul class="mh-tags"><li class="mh-tag">Visual identity</li><li class="mh-tag">UX/UI</li></ul></li>
      <li class="mh-project-card"><a class="mh-project-card__link" href="#"><div class="mh-project-card__meta mh-label"><span>2</span><span>/</span><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>AirPods Pro 3</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project</span></span></span></div><div class="mh-media" data-stroke><img src="../../assets/samples/airpods.jpg" alt=""></div></a><ul class="mh-tags"><li class="mh-tag">2D motion</li><li class="mh-tag">3D motion</li></ul></li>
    </ul>
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:var(--mh-project-grid-to-action)"><a class="mh-action" href="#"><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>View all</span><span aria-hidden="true">View all</span></span></span></a></div>
  </section>
</div>
```

## Rules

- **Selected-work order** is a curation decision (current: Gaia, AirPods Pro 3, Peak Energy, Motion Connect 2025, Simon & Schuster, National Park Playing Cards). It comes from the CMS, not code.
- Six projects, never more. Everything else lives in the Index.
- No hero image. The first image a visitor sees is project 1.
- Vertical rhythm (from the Framer page): hero padding 100px top and bottom (name at 101px and ~126px bottom on phone); Selected work rule 6px into its section (1px phone), rule → grid 45px (35px phone); grid → View all 30px (20 mobile); 100px section bottom padding before About; About rule → title 20px, title → content 30px (20 mobile); content → Scroll to top 60px.
- Selected work has no title; the label layer is hidden in Framer (node `XzikUe04m`). Rollback recipe: `code/mirror/backups/home-layout-2026-11-11/README.md`.
- About: 175px portrait (170 tablet/mobile), 20px gap, copy max 600px in Body L, 40px to Read more (30 tablet/mobile). On mobile the portrait stacks above the copy.

## Framer mapping

- Selected work: `HomeSelectedWorkGrid` (`FecepLS`), which also owns the About portrait/link linked hover.
- Boot and transitions: `PageTransition` (`gmalnRr`).
- Hero and footer-bar social labels: Text Flip Up (`TextEncryptionEffect.tsx`, `p7tSTaD`).

<!-- content/patterns/case-study.md -->

---
title: Case Study
section: Patterns
order: 2
description: The template every project page follows. Two-tone title, full-bleed media, fact sheet, then titled chapters of media and short text.
status: live
framer: Bespoke pages /case-studies/{slug} (one per CMS item)
---

# Case Study

## Goal

Show the work in context and say exactly what Micah did. The media carries the story; text is short, specific and in the first person.

## Structure

| # | Section | Components | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Nav | [Navigation](../components/navigation.md) | |
| 2 | Title | [Hero](../components/hero.md) (case-study) | Bold project name + Stroke Gray continuation, Display L |
| 3 | Hero media | [Media Frame](../components/media-frame.md) | Full bleed (edge to edge, no gutter), 16:9 or wider, video preferred |
| 4 | Fact sheet | [Meta Grid](../components/meta-grid.md) | About, Industry / Scope, Credits, Year |
| 5…n | Chapters | Heading (35px, near-black) + galleries + Body (18 / 16 / 18px, Graphite, ≤580px) | e.g. The Insight, Strategy, Visual Identity, Brand in the World, Interface, Designed to Ship |
| | Testimonial | [Testimonial](../components/testimonial.md) | Optional, real quotes only |
| n+1 | Other projects | [Section Header](../components/section-header.md), [Project Grid](../components/project-card.md) `data-columns="3"` | Three projects, no tags |
| n+2 | Footer | [Footer](../components/footer.md) | |

Every image on the page is [Lightbox](../components/lightbox.md)-enabled.

## Example (condensed)

```html example bleed
<article>
  <header class="mh-hero mh-container" data-variant="case-study" style="padding-bottom:72px">
    <h1 class="mh-hero__name">Gaia <span class="mh-hero__continuation">Turning noticing into a way of caring for the living world.</span></h1>
  </header>
  <div class="mh-media" data-ratio="16:9" data-mh-lightbox><img src="../../assets/samples/gaia.jpg" alt="Gaia app on a phone resting on a mirror in a field of daisies"></div>
  <div class="mh-container" style="padding-block:40px 72px">
    <div class="mh-meta-grid">
      <dl class="mh-meta-grid__col"><div class="mh-meta-grid__item"><dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ About the project</dt><dd class="mh-text-body-lg">A photograph becomes a data point. A data point becomes a record. A record becomes a reason to care.</dd></div></dl>
      <dl class="mh-meta-grid__col"><div class="mh-meta-grid__item"><dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Scope</dt><dd class="mh-text-body-lg">Visual Identity, UX/UI, Strategy</dd></div><div class="mh-meta-grid__item"><dt class="mh-label" data-leading="relaxed">/ Year</dt><dd class="mh-text-body-lg">2026</dd></div></dl>
    </div>
    <section style="margin-top:96px">
      <h2 class="mh-text-heading mh-text-strong" style="margin:0 0 40px">The Insight</h2>
      <p class="mh-text-body mh-text-body mh-measure" style="margin:0">iNaturalist lets people photograph an organism, record where they found it, and share it with a community that helps identify it.</p>
    </section>
  </div>
</article>
```

## Rules

- **Title**: the project name plus one line of what it does for people, in the visitor's terms. Under about 12 words in the continuation.
- **Chapters**: 4–7 chapters, each a Heading (sentence or Title Case as on the live pages), one gallery, and 1–3 short paragraphs. Paragraphs sit beside or under media, max 580px (full width on phones).
- **Text color**: chapter headings near-black (`--mh-text-strong`), body Graphite (`--mh-text-body`), meta values near-black.
- **Media first**: lead each chapter with media. Galleries use the case-study gallery components (justified grid, double stack, matched pair); don't invent new layouts.
- **Credits**: name collaborators and agencies precisely.
- **Work in progress**: unfinished case studies are gated by `CaseStudyWorkInProgressGate` (`Vu82U8E`); see `docs/case-study-wip-gate.md`.

## Framer mapping

- Each case study is a bespoke page per CMS item (`All Projects`, `yTHrQWMIY`); see `docs/case-study-cms-workflow.md` and `docs/case-study-seo-settings.md`.
- Page-wide controllers: `CaseStudyControllers` (`z13WRHS`, lightbox + link repair), `CaseStudyVideoManager` (`rGMwETR`), `CaseStudyMobileDescriptorLayout` (`W62Sy75`).
- Galleries: `CaseStudyJustifiedMediaGrid` (`c0iPrbN`), `DoubleStackGalleryGrid`, `MatchedStackMediaPair`, `FixedHeightMediaRows` (`IthLMt_`).
- Other projects: `OtherProjectCardRestored` (`vlwa5Cz`).

# Index

## Goal

Everything Micah has made, scannable in seconds and filterable by year, discipline and industry. Home curates; the Index is the full record.

## Structure

| # | Section | Components | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Example (condensed)

```html example bleed
<div class="mh-container" style="padding-block:40px 72px">

    <fieldset class="mh-filter__group"><legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Discipline</legend><button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Visual identity</button><button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">2D motion</button></fieldset>
    <fieldset class="mh-filter__group"><legend class="mh-filter__heading mh-label">Industry</legend><button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Nature</button><button class="mh-filter__item" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Technology</button></fieldset>
    <button class="mh-filter__clear mh-action" type="button">Clear filters</button>
  </div>
  <div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:16px">
    <div class="mh-view-toggle" role="group" aria-label="View"><button type="button" value="grid" aria-pressed="false">Grid</button><span aria-hidden="true">/</span><button type="button" value="list" aria-pressed="true">List</button></div>
  </div>
  <ol class="mh-index" reversed>
    <li class="mh-index__group"><h2 class="mh-index__year">2026</h2><ul class="mh-index__rows">
      <li><a class="mh-index__row" href="#"><span class="mh-index__title"><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Gaia</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project →</span></span></span></span><span class="mh-index__discipline mh-label">Visual identity, UX/UI</span><span class="mh-index__industry mh-label">Nature</span><span class="mh-index__row-year mh-label">2026</span></a></li>
      <li><a class="mh-index__row" href="#"><span class="mh-index__title"><span class="mh-flip"><span class="mh-flip__track"><span>Peak Energy</span><span aria-hidden="true">View project →</span></span></span></span><span class="mh-index__discipline mh-label">Visual identity</span><span class="mh-index__industry mh-label">Technology</span><span class="mh-index__row-year mh-label">2026</span></a></li>
    </ul></li>
  </ol>
</div>
```

## Rules

- List is the default view; Grid is one click away. Both read from the same CMS rows.
- Filters never move the layout: "Clear filters" is always rendered and only toggles visibility; the list doesn't remount on filter changes.
- Filter state lives in the URL (`#service=…` in, `?service=…` out) so filtered views can be shared.
- First arrival reveals content progressively (6 rows, then +12 per frame); later filter changes are instant.
- Every project in the CMS appears here, including ones not on Home.

## Framer mapping

- `IndexPageGridPreview` (`LgIzFjJ`) is the mounted wrapper and supplies `gridLayoutVariant="figma"`. Overwriting it silently breaks the grid. It wraps `IndexPage` (`rgAZFOv`).
- Read `docs/index-component-instructions.md` before any change. CMS mode is generated-module only; no `ProjectRegistrar`, manual `projects`, `DEFAULT_PROJECTS` or hard-coded media.

---

<!-- content/reference/changelog.md -->

---
title: Changelog
section: Reference
order: 1
description: How the live site and this design system have changed, newest first. Every other page describes the current state only.
---

# Changelog

Dates are when the change was published on micahhoang.com. Each entry names where the detail lives in the repo.

## 2026-11-27: design system consolidation

- Pages merged, 34 → 27 (plus this changelog): Principles absorbs Interaction Principles; Motion absorbs Gesture; Texture absorbs Grain Overlay; **Links & Actions** replaces Text Link, Action and Scroll to Top; Project Card absorbs Project Grid; **Index Controls** replaces Filter Group and View Toggle.
- Tokens: per-component values moved from `layout` into a `component` group. Renamed: `heading-word-gap` → `section-header-word-gap`, `section-rule-after` → `section-header-rule-after`, `card-grid-to-action` → `project-grid-to-action`, `cta-row-gap` / `cta-suffix-gap` → `footer-row-gap` / `footer-suffix-gap`, `pill-scroll-clearance` → `tag-scroll-clearance`, `nav-gutter` → `gutter`. Removed (unused or retired): `about-image-width`, `about-copy-width`, `space-13`, `duration-slow`, `type.label-sm`, `bg-inverse`.
- History moved here; pages are present tense.
- Found on the live site while syncing: footer "Get in touch" now keeps its 130% leading on tablet and phone (it used to drop to 100%), so the contact rows sit 4px lower there.

## 2026-11-23: one flip timing, social flip-ups, responsive case-study media

- Every text flip (nav, links, project titles, Index rows, Scroll to top, Play labels) runs 420ms Snappy through one variable, `--mh-flip-duration`, set in `ResumeAssetHost` and `0ms` under reduced motion. Index rows were 620ms.
- Hero and footer-bar social labels flip up one line instead of scrambling (`TextEncryptionEffect.tsx`, `p7tSTaD`, now "Text Flip Up").
- Case-study images serve responsive sizes; offscreen Simon & Schuster spreads load late (`code/mirror/case-media-2026-11-23.json`).

## 2026-11-11: Home simplification, monogram, Index refinements

- Home: the Selected work title was removed (Framer node `XzikUe04m` hidden; rollback in `code/mirror/backups/home-layout-2026-11-11/`). The rule now sits 45px above the grid (35px phone).
- Home hero name moved into normal flow with a phone-fluid size, `min(58px, (100vw − 40px) / 6.2)`, so it can't overflow narrow screens. Before, it was absolutely positioned 10px up and 6px left.
- The boot loader shows the ©MH monogram (Figma `168:541`) at 237.5 / 190px, replacing the full wordmark.
- Index: the project count cross-fades changed digits in fixed slots; mobile filter panels grow from their trigger (250ms in, 150ms out).
- Nav rollover labels both use 100% leading, so the replacement lands exactly on the resting label.

## 2026-10-30: mobile pass

- Mobile gutter unified to 20px on every route (was 15px, 14px on Index).
- 44px minimum touch targets for every mobile link, pill, filter, toggle, menu button and footer row.
- Phone reading text 18px / 140% (Body L was 15px / 130%, Body M 14px); Heading 3 is 28px on tablet and 24px on phone.
- Every mono label is 13px; the 12px tablet/mobile tag size is gone. Mobile pills are 44px tall with 24px side padding, in a single row that scrolls edge to edge.
- Stroke Gray lightened from `#707070` to `#848484` (3.43:1), the midpoint between the darker contrast fix and the original `#979797`.
- Native mobile navigation: name + MENU, full-screen Forest Green panel.
- Index: Year / Service / Industry disclosure buttons on mobile; rows carry their own year.
- Footer: GitHub added as a fourth contact; phone contact labels are fluid (28–38px).
- Case-study headings on mobile reveal line by line; a head stylesheet renders them in place under reduced motion.
- Detail: the dated notes in `docs/` (e.g. `mobile-type-gutters-footer-2026-10-30.md`).

## 2026-10-23: vector loader identity, Play drawer

- The boot loader showed an outlined © Micah Hoang wordmark (Figma `91:521`) instead of text. The monogram replaced it on 2026-11-11.
- `/play` drawer: 500ms open / 400ms close on the Smooth curve; Safari idle-drift fix.

## 2026-10-01: first version

- Design system created from the published site and the Framer project: tokens, docs site, agent files and the QA fixture.

---
